revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a warehouse passage with pallets, shelving, clear floor markings, painted loading-bay concrete, and neutral indoor illumination. Rear-oblique view, slightly distant framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, and enough surrounding context to judge body support. A tall adult with a broad build wearing a reflective work vest over light neutral clothing is seated normally on a stable office chair, pelvis supported by the chair, torso upright. The subject is clearly visible. Include a doorway and structural lines creating depth without blocking the subject. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, artificial annotation, training signs, simulation text, medical staff, ambulances, first-aid equipment, cones, instruction boards, or dataset labels.
